profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Block | Leading Mission-Critical System Migrations & Data Integrity | Specialist in Scalable Backend Services
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer | High-Scale Distributed Systems & Mission-Critical Infrastructure



I am a Senior Software Engineer specializing in the design and delivery of resilient, high-throughput production systems within highly regulated environments. Currently at Block, I lead cross-team technical initiatives, including large-scale sanctions screening migrations and the development of encrypted PII data pipelines that reduced delivery SLAs from hours to minutes.



My expertise lies in ensuring transactional data integrity, implementing complex concurrency controls, and driving operational savings through modernizing legacy infrastructure. I have a proven track record of leading zero-downtime migrations (Ruby/Rails, Kotlin/Spring) and mentoring engineering teams to peak productivity.



Core Expertise:

Systems: Distributed Systems, Event-Driven Architecture, Idempotency Design, Data Pipeline Design.

Technologies: Java, Kotlin, Python, Ruby, TypeScript, AWS, Kafka, Snowflake, Terraform.

Impact: Led technical design for Afterpay’s compliance migrations and resolved critical financial accuracy defects in high-volume payment flows.



I am passionate about building scalable solutions that empower global economic access while maintaining the highest standards of system reliability and security.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
●​ Owned technical design and cross-team delivery of Afterpay’s sanctions screening migration to Block’s Entity Screener (Java, Kotlin, Spring), coordinating across 4 repositories and 3 teams; implemented shadow mode validation and resilience improvements to meet compliance error thresholds.

●​ Authored architecture decision records (ADRs) on historical screening data strategy adopted across the compliance engineering organization.

●​ Built encrypted PII data pipelines (Kotlin, Terraform, Snowflake) publishing due diligence and incarceration monitoring records with reconciliation validation and latency monitoring, reducing data delivery SLA from hours to minutes.

●​ Designed and shipped concurrency and idempotency controls (Kotlin, Misk) eliminating race conditions that caused duplicate financial operations in production.

●​ Resolved critical financial accuracy defects including merchant double settlement and chargeback discount miscalculations across high-volume payment flows.

●​ Led infrastructure upgrades across production compliance systems (Ruby, Rails 7, Ruby 3.2, Sidekiq 7, Redis namespace migration) to maintain security compliance and enable dependency modernization.

●​ Scaled the engineering organization by conducting 40+ technical/behavioral interviews while mentoring 3 new hires to full productivity; led a talk at a team offsite on system reliability creating ARDs that informed the design for our system's rewrite.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected dispute money movement system end-to-end (Kotlin, Misk, Kafka) including transitory storage, financial ledgering, event publishing, clawback flows, and settlement reporting for card and network disputes.
Designed customer profile deletion system (Ruby, Rails) removing 200M+ records from Entity Screener, reducing storage costs by $100K+ monthly while preserving screening integrity.
Built modular side-effects architecture (Ruby, Rails, Sidekiq) decoupling orchestration from 7 downstream actions, enabling independent iteration across screening stages.
Created cross-language profile checksum system (Java, Ruby, Kafka) including calculator, screening receipt integration, backfill jobs, and change receipt pipeline via SQS/SNS/Lambda.
Upgraded LexisNexis sanctions screening API from V9 to V12 (Ruby, Rails) with staged rollout, managing production reverts and roll-forwards.
Screened 1M+ customers during Entity Screener launch to meet contractual onboarding requirements for a major business partner.
Built MRM P0 analysis and reporting tasks (Ruby, SQL) for merchant risk management, optimizing query performance by migrating to Customer table lookups.

positions.title: Game Developer
positions.description: Participating in Microsofts Game Camp powered by Unity where my team and I will develop a game in 6 months or less.
